title: Adobe Connect is affected by an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability that could…
description: Adobe Connect has a code injection vulnerability (CWE-94) that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as visiting a malicious URL or interacting with a compromised web page. The vulnerability affects the scope of the application and has a critical severity rating with a CVSS score of 9.6.
